scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:python && npm run build:functions
scripts.lint: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 eslint apps/web apps/web-function apps/cma-preview apps/preview apps/slack-preview e2e playwright.config.ts playwright.live.config.ts playwright.production.config.ts && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --directory backend ruff check src tests ../scripts
scripts.format:check:python: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --directory backend ruff format --check src tests ../scripts
scripts.format:python: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --directory backend ruff format src tests ../scripts
scripts.typecheck: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 npm run typecheck -w @managed-agents/web && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --directory backend mypy src && npm run typecheck:functions
scripts.test: npm run test:e2e-helpers && npm run test:python && npm run test:functions
scripts.test:python: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --directory backend pytest --ignore=tests/integration
scripts.db:migrate: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --directory backend python -m managed_agents_app.operations migrate
scripts.db:seed: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --directory backend python -m managed_agents_app.operations seed
scripts.db:map-slack: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --directory backend python -m managed_agents_app.operations map-slack
scripts.secrets:sync: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --directory backend python -m managed_agents_app.operations sync-secrets
scripts.test:live: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --directory backend python ../scripts/live.py
scripts.verify:full: npm run check && npm run e2e:production && npm run build:python && npm run build:functions && npm run terraform:validate && npm run e2e
scripts.test:functions: vitest run apps/web-function/tests apps/cma-preview/tests apps/preview/tests apps/slack-preview/tests
scripts.typecheck:functions: npm run typecheck -w @managed-agents/web-function && npm run typecheck -w @managed-agents/cma-preview && npm run typecheck -w @managed-agents/preview && npm run typecheck -w @managed-agents/slack-preview
